tagline: Leading global technology company in electrification, automation, and digitalization
hero_kpi_rationale: The Electrification segment is ABB's main growth engine, driven by the energy transition and demand for intelligent and sustainable electrical solutions, representing the most significant share of its revenue and long-term strategy.

ai_positioning.summary: ABB is gradually integrating artificial intelligence into its automation and predictive maintenance solutions, without making it a central pillar of its communication. AI is used to optimize equipment performance and enhance cybersecurity.
evidence: AI integrated into predictive maintenance services via ABB Ability
Use of advanced analytics for industrial process optimization
Development of embedded solutions with machine learning capabilities

kpis.name: Electrification Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated by sales of electrical products and energy distribution solutions.
kpis.description: The Electrification segment is the largest contributor to ABB's revenue, driven by digitalization of electrical grids and renewable solutions.

kpis.name: Motion Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue from industrial motors, converters and drives.
kpis.description: The Motion segment benefits from industrial demand for low-carbon emission solutions.

kpis.name: Process Automation Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue related to automation solutions for the process industry.
kpis.description: Portfolio including automation, cybersecurity and advanced digital services.

kpis.name: Robotics & Discrete Automation Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue from industrial robots, discrete automation and associated digital solutions.
kpis.description: Segment including collaborative robots, programmable logic controllers and automated transport systems.

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Gross Margin — gross profit divided by revenue.
kpis.description: Gross margin slightly rising, supported by better product mix and operational gains.

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.description: Operating margin improves thanks to cost savings and rigorous management.

kpis.name: R&D as % of Revenue
kpis.description: R&D focused on embedded software, AI in automation and digital solutions.

kpis.name: Capital Expenditures
kpis.explanation: Capital Expenditures — investments in property, plant and equipment.
kpis.description: Investments primarily in smart factories and digital platforms.

kpis.name: Total Employees
kpis.explanation: Headcount — total number of employees at period end.
kpis.description: Moderately declining headcount, reflecting cost optimization and internal automation.

kpis.name: Orders
kpis.explanation: Measures the number of orders received by ABB, key indicator of future demand and business health.

kpis.name: Book-to-Bill
kpis.explanation: Ratio of received orders to sales made. Shows if ABB has more future work than current production.

kpis.name: Free Cash Flow
kpis.explanation: Cash actually available after investments to reward shareholders and repay debt.

kpis.name: Electrification Op Margin
kpis.explanation: Measures ABB's Electrification division profitability: what percentage of revenue becomes profit.

kpis.name: Motion Op Margin
kpis.explanation: Measures Motion division's profitability: what percentage of revenue becomes operating profit from motors business.

kpis.name: Dividend
kpis.explanation: Measures the cash ABB distributes annually to shareholders as a reward for their investment.

kpis.name: Net Cash
kpis.explanation: Measures cash available after debt repayment: shows financial health and investment capacity.

kpis.name: Dividend Per Share
kpis.explanation: Dividend Per Share — total dividends paid divided by shares outstanding.
kpis.description: Dividend per share paid annually, aggregated from yfinance.dividends over the last 7 fiscal years reported by the company.
kpis.signal: Shareholder returns growing, dividend policy supportive

kpis.name: Capital Returned (Dividends)
kpis.explanation: Capital Return — total cash returned to shareholders (dividends + buybacks).
kpis.description: Capital returned to shareholders via annual dividends, extracted from yfinance.cashflow over the last 4 reported fiscal years.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.explanation: Payout Ratio — dividends paid divided by net income.
kpis.description: Payout ratio = Dividends paid / Net income, calculated over the last 4 fiscal years from yfinance.cashflow and yfinance.income_stmt.
kpis.signal: Dividend cut risk, monitor payout sustainability
